// Usage fixture for the TypeScript check of the kitchen-sink types: values a
// client writes against the generated interfaces. Every line must type-check;
// each `@ts-expect-error` line must fail.

import type {
  CollectionSlug,
  PostsData,
  PostsDocument,
  PostsLocalizedDocument,
  SettingsData,
  Update,
} from "./types.ts";

// A create carries every required field; an optional one may be null.
export const created: PostsData = {
  title: "Hello",
  status: "draft",
  author: "u1",
  tab_note: "note",
  summary: null,
  seo: { meta_title: "SEO" },
  items: [{ label: "first", meta: { key: "k" } }],
};

// An update sends any subset — a group's sub-fields too; a row is whole and
// keeps its id.
export const updated: Update<PostsData> = {
  summary: null,
  seo: { meta_desc: "only this" },
  items: [{ id: "r1", label: "kept" }],
};

export const settings: Update<SettingsData> = {};

// @ts-expect-error a required field cannot be cleared
export const clearedRequired: Update<PostsData> = { author: null };

// @ts-expect-error a group has no value of its own to clear
export const clearedGroup: Update<PostsData> = { seo: null };

// @ts-expect-error an array row is written whole: its required label stays
export const partialRow: Update<PostsData> = { items: [{ id: "r1" }] };

// A read: every field optional, a reference an id or its document.
export function authorId(doc: PostsDocument): string | undefined {
  const author = doc.author;
  if (author == null) return undefined;
  return typeof author === "string" ? author : author.id;
}

// Every locale at once: a localized field is a per-locale map.
export function germanSummary(doc: PostsLocalizedDocument): string | null | undefined {
  return doc.summary?.de;
}

export const slug: CollectionSlug = "posts";
